name: ash
enchant_note: Ash, the wood of the World Tree, takes a rune well.
protection_note: A shield's ash: held, not worn, so it guards with its AC alone.
lore_descriptor: pale and straight-grained, the wood chosen for spear shafts because it bends before it breaks
first_pickup_chronicle: Took up an ash shield, the kind Vikings studded with iron.
